notes.title: 🛠️ Development Update - July
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The halls are still. The Sisters remain deep in preparation.

We haven’t called for you again, yet, but that doesn’t mean nothing’s stirring.
Small pieces have been moving. Systems tighten. Scenes lock. Ritual paths sharpen. And deep under the cathedral, something hums.



You’ve already glimpsed the cards. Felt the weight of choice. But there are still threads left hanging... [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658303/71068cb82c1003abc974c0d9c2e729feb6d2b0eb.png"]


Here’s what’s being fine-tuned:
Dialogue refinements based on internal feedback (yes, she got meaner)

Tweaks to the Ritual System to increase variance on repeat attempts

UI clarity passes, especially around timed decision points

Sound and audio cues are getting a fresh layering of dread



We’re not making noise. We’re making sure that when the time comes, you don’t miss your step.

Wishlist if you haven’t already, or revisit if you’re waiting. The descent is closer than it seems.

— Team Hell’s Bells

notes.title: 🛠️ Development Update - June
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The work continues. Quiet, focused, and more ambitions than before:

🕯️ Here's what's taking shape:
Unique ritual mechanics for each sister: This will add variety, RNG, unpredictability, and a dash of occult spice to every route you take

Minigames with branching outcomes: This will deepen interactivity, and make the world of Hell's Bells just a bit more perilous

Quick time events: Similar to the minigames, this will bring moments of urgency and quick-thinking to the choices that you make. Choose wisely, and quickly!

Expanded dialog paths: Along with the forementioned rituals, these will bring new and expanded dialog paths for you to navigate



These updates are aimed at making Hell's Bells not just a single experience, but a deep and choice-driven world all relying on your choices.



No major announcements as of yet, but momentum is building!



— Team Hell’s Bells
